name: Lever
notes: Postings API api.lever.co/v0/postings/{site}. Write API: API key. Reading jobs needs auth: no (read). Parent Employ Inc. is named in the site footer. Pricing is by custom quote on request. Partner program page lists integration partnerships. No language options or own-domain API page found.
